title: The first morning
notes: The tutorial, 'The first morning' (GDD D-50, D-52, D-57): a guided, linear story on the village map that teaches the systems through its own small problems (never the gate beam, the bar or the compass). It ends the way the main game is meant to be won: Kade, who trusts only what he sees, watches the stranger help, fight and make fire, and speaks for them to the captain, who lets them in (himself if Kade told him the stranger wants in, otherwise when asked). Each step: title; cards (what the device says, shown big in the centre with the game paused, read with Next); task (the one line on the banner until it's done); focus (what the world marker points at: {cell}, {object} or [objects], {npc}); suggest (exact words to try: text, to (the person addressed, or null), mode (say or do, D-55), button (offer 'Type it for me')); check (an outcome in the world or a ui action, checked by code, and only once the step's cards are read); done (the praise card); help (shown on H, most specific last); triggers, on_start and on_done (the story acting: someone speaks, walks over, lends something, goes to tell someone, a bout begins). Text may use {KEY} for a key cap: {W} {A} {S} {D} {Shift} {E} {I} {T} {H} {F} {X} {Q} {Space} {Esc} {Enter} {Left-click} {Right-click}. Conditions are the rule language (backend/rules.py, D-58): all/any/not of others; flag (something the story noted); heard_from with after_s; talked_to with since_step; holding_shield; made_seen (something with this flag made this step, seen by this person); vouched (this person has spoken for the stranger to the captain); admitted. Effects (backend/scenario.py), each only if its optional when holds: npc_says, hold (stand and talk a moment), keep (stay with the stranger for seconds), approach with stop, lend, hurt, errand, spar (with a practice weapon), vouch (a speech's words to the captain; its notes are what the story remembers they knew), admit (the captain lets them in on a word he holds). A trigger with skippable false isn't run by the developer's skip. things: the story's own objects (carried_by someone, or at x, y). roles: what the story asks of a person during some steps: stays (renew their stay with the stranger while this holds), withholds (moves they won't make in conversation), spars (a blow at them starts the bout: says, with, marks the triggers it stands for). speeches: words used by more than one effect, which may depend on what the story noted (when).

things.name: practice sword
things.description: A wooden practice sword of ash, its edges rounded and its tip padded with leather.

things.name: practice sword
things.description: Kade's own wooden practice sword, its grip worn smooth and its padding thin.

things.name: wicker shield
things.description: A round shield of woven willow on a wooden rim, light and springy.

things.name: broken steel file
things.description: Half of a smith's worn-out file, snapped off: hard, high-carbon steel, still gritty with its teeth.

spars.says: Ha! Straight in, is it? Only practice, then: nobody bleeds.

why: they dressed Jory's burn, held their own in a bout with me, and struck fire from flint and steel in front of me. Practical hands.

why.text: And they want to come into the city.

summary: Kade vouched for the stranger: saw them dress Jory's burn, hold their own in a bout with Kade, and strike fire from flint and steel.

summary.text: The stranger wants to come into the city.

steps.title: Awake
cards: …signal. There you are. Don't be alarmed: it's me, the device you came through with. I'm damaged, but I can still talk, and only you can hear me.
You're on a road below a walled city, a very long way back in time. I'll show you how things work here, one thing at a time.
While I'm talking, the world waits for you. Read at your own pace, then press {Enter} or click Next.

steps.title: Walking
cards: First, walking. Use {W} {A} {S} {D} or the arrow keys. Hold {Shift} to run.
See the glowing ring a little way up the road? Walk into it.
steps.task: Walk into the glowing ring up the road
steps.done: Good. You can go anywhere you like here.
help: Press {W} (or the up arrow) to walk north, towards the top of the screen.
The ring is just a few steps up the road from where you started. The arrow at the edge of the screen points to it when it's out of sight.

steps.title: Looking closer
cards: Everything here is real: it has weight, it's made of something, and someone may own it. Nothing is scenery just because it's small.
Hover the mouse over anything to see its name. {Right-click} it to look closer. Try it on the plantain leaves, in the ring.
steps.task: Right-click the plantain leaves to look closer
steps.done: That card tells you what a thing is, what it's made of, and whose it is. Click anywhere else to close it.
help: Move the mouse over the plantain leaves (in the ring), then press the right mouse button.

steps.title: Your hands
cards: You arrived with nothing but your clothes. Let's change that.
{Left-click} something to pick it up (you walk there first), or stand next to it and press {E}. Pick up the plantain leaves.
steps.task: Pick up the plantain leaves: left-click them
steps.done: In your pack now, along the bottom of the screen. Plantain is a healing herb: keep it.
help: Point at the plantain leaves and press the left mouse button. Or walk right up to them and press {E}.

steps.title: Two more things
cards: Two more: the flint shard and the bundle of dry grass. Both are marked. You'll want them later.
steps.task: Pick up the flint shard and the dry grass
steps.done: Watch the weight on the right of your pack: you can carry about twenty kilos.
help: Both are just beside the road, a little west of where you woke. Follow the rings.
{Left-click} each one.

steps.title: Your pack
cards: Press {I} to open Pack & gear. It shows what's in your hands, what you wear, what you carry, and any wounds you have.
Have a look, then close it again with {Esc}.
steps.task: Press I to open Pack & gear
steps.done: You'll use Pack & gear to hold weapons and to treat wounds. Close it with {Esc} whenever you like.
help: Press the {I} key on your keyboard.

steps.title: A cry from the smithy

on_start.text: Ahh! The tongs slipped. My arm, it's burning! Aunt Mara!
Jory! Hold still, let me see. That's a bad one, and I've nothing here for burns.

cards: Did you hear that? Someone's hurt, over at the smithy to the north-west.
It's Jory, the smith's apprentice. He's marked: follow the arrow at the edge of the screen. Hold {Shift} to run.
steps.task: Go to Jory at the smithy
steps.done: There he is. The woman with him is Mara, his aunt, the smith.
help: Follow the arrow at the edge of the screen: north-west, past the inn.
Hold {Shift} while you walk to run.

steps.title: Talking
cards: Talking is simple: {Left-click} a person, or press {T}. The box at the bottom opens.

Type in your own words. What you SAY shows blue; what you DO shows red. {Tab} switches between them, even halfway through a line, so you can say something and do something in one go. There are no lines to choose from: people answer as themselves.
Try these words, or your own:
steps.task: Talk to Jory: click him, type, press Enter
steps.done: Notice Mara listening in: anyone near enough can join a conversation. They'll remember what you said, and how you said it.
help: {Left-click} Jory to open the dialogue bar, type something, and press {Enter}.
Or press Type it for me on the card, then {Enter}.

steps.title: Something for the burn
cards: That burn needs dressing, or it will fester within the hour. You know more about burns than anyone alive here.
To make something, press {Tab} until DO is lit (your words turn red), then describe what you do. The world decides whether it works, and tells you why when it doesn't.
Try this:

suggest.text: crush the plantain leaves into a poultice for a burn

steps.task: Make a poultice from the plantain leaves
steps.done: You made that. It exists now: nobody in this world had one until you did.
help: Press {T}, type what you do with the plantain leaves, and press {Enter}.
If it didn't work, the dialogue bar says why. Try again with the words on the card: "crush the plantain leaves into a poultice for a burn".

steps.title: Treat Jory
cards: Now put it on him yourself. Telling Jory what to do isn't the same as doing it: say what you do.
Stand beside Jory and try this:

suggest.text: lay the poultice on Jory's burn and bind it

steps.task: Put the poultice on Jory's burn

on_done.text: That was decent of you, stranger. Kade from the gate should meet you: he sizes up everyone new on this road, and he's fair to anyone who can really do things. Wait here: I'll bring him.

on_done.message: There's a stranger at the smithy who just dressed Jory's burn, and did it well. You'll want to see them for yourself.

steps.done: He'll remember that. So will Mara. Kindness counts here the way evidence does: people trust what they've seen you do. The same goes for you: cuts, burns and breaks need something made for them.
help: Say what YOU do, not what Jory should do: "lay the poultice on Jory's burn and bind it".
Or hand it to him (drag it from your pack onto Jory) and he can put it on himself.
Or press Type it for me on the card, then {Enter}.

steps.title: A guard comes over
cards: Mara has gone to fetch Kade, one of the gate guards. People here pass things on to each other, good and bad.
Kade trusts only what he sees people do with his own eyes. Wait here for them, or walk to meet them.
steps.task: Wait for Mara to bring Kade (or walk to meet them)

do.text: Handy with a burn, are they? I'll come and see.

So you're the one who dressed Jory's arm. No name, no papers, and walking this road alone? It's thick with cutpurses. Let's see if you can look after yourself. Here: a practice sword and a wicker shield.

steps.done: A practice sword and a wicker shield, lent to you. Lent things are yours to use, not to keep.
help: Mara walks to Kade and tells him about you; then they both come back. Kade is marked.
If it's taking too long, walk towards Kade: he's marked with a ring.

steps.title: Arm yourself
cards: Press {I} for Pack & gear. Click the practice sword and choose Right hand. Then click the wicker shield and choose Left hand.
Out in the world, {Space} uses your right hand and {F} your left. Hold {F} with a shield to raise it. {X} swaps your hands.
steps.task: Press I: the sword in your right hand, the shield in your left
steps.done: A sword like this needs one hand, so the other can hold a shield. A staff or a spear reaches further, but takes both hands. Armour matters more than anything: remember that when you meet the guards in mail.
help: Press {I}. Find the practice sword and press Right hand; then the wicker shield and press Left hand.
Some weapons, like a staff or a spear, take both hands: then there's no hand left for a shield.

steps.title: Kade's bout
cards: Kade wants to see whether you can look after yourself. It's only practice: nobody bleeds.
Fights happen in real time. Every blow winds up first: watch for the red mark over his head, and step back out of reach before it lands. Swing with {Space} while he recovers.
Hold {F} to raise the shield against blows from the front. If it goes badly, press {T} and say you give up. Walk up to Kade to begin.
steps.task: Walk up to Kade and spar: Space swings, hold F to block

do.text: Right then. Only practice: nobody bleeds. Show me.

steps.done: Win or lose, you know how a fight goes now. A real one won't stop at 'enough'. Choose your fights carefully.
help: Walk right up to Kade with the sword in your right hand.
When the red mark shows over his head, step back or hold {F}. Then step in and press {Space}.
Hold {F} with the shield facing him to take his blows.

steps.title: What brings you here?

on_start.text: Not bad. You're no soldier, but you keep your head. So what's someone like you doing on this road?

cards: Kade wants to know what you're after. Tell him, in your own words: people act on what they know about you, and pass it on.

suggest.text: I'm trying to get into the city.

steps.done: Whatever you told him, he'll remember, and he may pass it on to someone who matters.
help: Click Kade, type why you're here, and press {Enter}.
Or press Type it for me on the card, then {Enter}.

steps.title: Your real advantage
cards: Here's your real advantage: you know things nobody here has worked out yet. Kade trusts only what he sees people do, so let's show him.
First, pick up the broken steel file lying by the smithy. Steel, not iron: flint throws good sparks only off hard steel.
steps.task: Pick up the broken steel file by the smithy
steps.done: Flint, steel and dry grass: you have everything you need to make fire.
help: The file is marked with a ring, just by the smithy.

steps.title: Fire from a stone
cards: Now make a fire where Kade can see it. Stand near him, make sure DO is lit, and type it yourself this time:

suggest.text: strike the flint against the steel file so the sparks fall into the dry grass, then blow on it until it catches

steps.task: Make a fire where Kade can see it

on_done.text: Fire in a few strikes, from a scrap of steel and a stone. That's useful work. I've seen enough: the captain should hear about you.

steps.done: Did you see his face? Kade doesn't care for tricks, but he respects work that works. That's worth more than any argument.
help: Stand within a few steps of Kade, press {T}, make sure DO is lit (red), type the words from the card and press {Enter}.
If it doesn't catch, the bar says why. Hold the flint and the file low over the grass, and blow on the sparks.
Anything that really makes a fire counts: you don't have to use my words.

steps.title: The captain's word
cards: Kade is off to the gate to tell Captain Roderic about you. Only the captain decides who enters the city.
If Kade told him you want to come in, Roderic may come to you himself. If not, go to the gate and ask him: he can't let you in if he doesn't know you want to come.
steps.task: Get Captain Roderic to let you into the city

do.text: Kade tells me you dressed the smith's boy's burn, stood a bout with him, and struck fire from a stone in front of him. And that you want to come into the city. His word is good enough for me: you may enter.

steps.done: You're in. That's how it works here: people watch what you do, pass it on, and speak for you.
help: Kade walks to the gate and speaks to the captain. Roderic is marked.
If Roderic hasn't come to you, walk to the gate, click him, and ask to be let into the city.
Tell him Kade can speak for you. He listens to people he trusts.

steps.title: The city
cards: That's everything I can teach you. The gate is open to you: walk through it whenever you're ready.

A new journey starts again on the south road, with other people's problems and nobody handing you the answer. How you get in is up to you: by what you make, what you show, who comes to trust you, or something nobody has thought of.

One more thing: in the bottom-right corner of the map is an old wainwright's yard, full of materials anyone may take, and the wainwright's notebook, full of ways to make weapons, armour and remedies. Pick it up and click it in your pack to read it.
I'll stay quiet from here. If you're stuck, press {H} and ask me. I'll point you somewhere, but I won't solve it for you.

reactions.killed: …You killed someone. That can't be undone, and everyone who saw it will remember. If that isn't what you meant, rewind from the menu: Rewind to the last calm moment.
reactions.arrested: They've taken you away from the gate. It isn't over: you can still find another way. Or rewind from the menu to try again.
reactions.dead: You died. Rewind to the last calm moment and try something else.
